intro.title: Build order placement API with validation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple order placement API endpoint using Node.js and Express. You'll learn how to validate incoming order data, such as checking for required fields and ensuring correct data types, to prevent errors and improve security. The core programming concept is input validation, which is essential for handling user data safely in web applications. You'll use JavaScript, Express middleware, and basic HTTP methods to create a POST endpoint that accepts and validates order details. By the end, you'll have a functional API that can receive order requests and respond with appropriate validation messages.
intro.usecase: Order placement APIs with validation are fundamental to e-commerce platforms like Amazon or Shopify, where customers submit purchase requests that must be validated before processing. In financial applications such as Robinhood or Coinbase, these APIs ensure trade orders meet regulatory requirements and account limits before execution. Restaurant delivery apps like DoorDash use similar validation to confirm order details, pricing, and availability before charging customers. Developers implementing these APIs prevent invalid data from reaching business logic, reducing errors and improving system reliability.
